classification: post-result paired uncertainty analysis; no method development or parameter selection

primary_endpoint.name: wavelet_minus_fixed4_weak_auc
primary_endpoint.pairing: the same bootstrap multiplicities are applied to both methods
primary_endpoint.auc_definition: pairwise concordance with half credit for ties

bootstrap.combined_effect: equal-weight mean of the independently resampled 2025 and 2023 differences

interpretation_rules.decisive_wavelet_advantage: both per-year 95 percent intervals exclude zero above and the combined interval excludes zero above
interpretation_rules.consistent_but_uncertain_wavelet_advanta: point estimate is positive in both years, combined bootstrap probability of a positive difference exceeds 0.90, and at least one required interval includes zero
interpretation_rules.no_replicated_advantage: the point-estimate ordering does not remain positive in both years or the combined positive probability is at most 0.90
interpretation_rules.uniform_dominance: prohibited unless wavelet recall differences are nonnegative at every k and alpha and false-positive differences are nonpositive at every alpha in both years
